name: LexisNexis
instructions: Open https://consumer.risk.lexisnexis.com/opt and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. The site asks for a Social Security or driver's license number, which OpenOptOut never fills in; only finish it if you're comfortable sharing that with them. Use {contact_email} if it asks for an email address. Then press "I've done this".
notes: LexisNexis asks for a Social Security or driver's license number to find the record. OpenOptOut never fills those in, so a person decides whether to finish it. LexisNexis also takes opt-outs by phone at 1-888-497-0011. Some records (for law enforcement and fraud prevention) are kept regardless.
source: Process per redact.dev's LexisNexis removal guide (updated 2026-08-10).
